wing_name: Off-Hours Sign-in, Then a Credential Tool (Behaviour)
description: One person signs in or unlocks the computer between 22:00 and 04:59 in the case's own time zone and, within two hours, a known credential-dumping tool runs (Mimikatz, ProcDump, Rubeus, LaZagne, SafetyKatz, nanodump, secretsdump and others). UBA rules: interactive_logon / workstation_unlock (hour_local, from the registry time-zone bias at collection) then program_run / process_created (by program name). A Prefetch run records no account, so that step takes the machine's events too; the hit still needs the person's own sign-in. Renamed tools are not caught by name.
proves: A known credential tool ran soon after a person signed in at night
author: Crow-Eye Team
